title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Haul-Away and Stair-Carry Schedule
content:
Each Northgate Delivery & Installation service level states whether its crew removes old items and carries merchandise on stairs, how many old items and flights are included in the base fee, the fee for each one beyond those included, and the most flights the crew will carry.

## Haul-away of old items

| Service level | Haul-away available | Old items removed at no charge | Fee per old item beyond those included |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | No | 0 | $0.00 |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | No | 0 | $0.00 |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | Yes | 0 | $25.00 |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | Yes | 1 | $25.00 |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | Yes | 1 | $25.00 |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | Yes | 1 | $25.00 |

## Stair carry

| Service level | Stair carry available | Flights included in the base fee | Fee per flight beyond those included | Most flights carried |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | No | 0 | $0.00 | 0 |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | No | 0 | $0.00 | 0 |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | Yes | 1 | $20.00 | 3 |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | Yes | 2 | $20.00 | 3 |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | Yes | 2 | $35.00 | 2 |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | Yes | 1 | $20.00 | 3 |

## Questions the schedule answers

**Which levels carry no stairs and remove no old items?** Northgate Curbside Delivery and Northgate Threshold Delivery.

**Which levels include one old item in the base fee?** Northgate White Glove Delivery, Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation and Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation. Room of Choice removes old items but includes none.

**Where is a flight of stairs most expensive?** At Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation, $35.00 a flight beyond the 2 included, and that level carries no more than 2 flights in all.

**Hypothetical flights.** At Northgate Room of Choice Delivery, 3 flights means 1 flight included and 2 flights beyond it, at $20.00 each, $40.00. At Northgate White Glove Delivery the same 3 flights means 2 included and 1 beyond, $20.00. A fourth flight is beyond the most flights either level carries.
